fingerprint.structure: 8 slides: hook ('WEAK BACK?') → anatomy overview ('Let's fix that…', 4 muscle insets around a color-coded back) → 5 muscle slides (lats x2, traps, rear delts, erectors), each with a muscle-map icon + sets x reps + two exercises joined by 'OR' → CTA (eBook)
fingerprint.hook: Two-word problem question 'WEAK BACK?' over the mascot flexing a back double-bicep with color-coded muscles
fingerprint.camera_motion: 2d-characters (mascot) on designed cards; illustrations only; 4:5 slides
fingerprint.pacing: 8 slides, almost no body text: each muscle slide is a heading, a sets x reps line and two illustrated options
fingerprint.text_overlay: Headings: Anton-like condensed heavy grotesque, Title Case (ALL CAPS on covers), navy #041732 with accent blue; '#N' numerals in blue, slightly italic; short blue underline (about 12.6% wide) under each heading; body: Didact Gothic-like light sans, gray #4b4945, about 2.7% of frame height, left-aligned at x=10%, 2 to 4 short lines; BLUE BRO logo top-left on every slide; muscle slides put a small muscle-map icon left of the title
fingerprint.audio: third-party sound (library-style title and author), not original, no voiceover; slideshow so the sound is only background
fingerprint.arc: Name the problem → show the muscles → one choice of two exercises per muscle → sell the program
